messages:
sarah_marketing: Quick ask 80 we need a reproducible bench bundle for the webinar next Wed: raw logs, CSVs, one-page memo + short narrative. Can eng/runtime run a small matrix and drop artifacts in S3?

kevin_runtime: Sure. What exact matrix do you want (models, seqs, batches, quant), and which hardware? Also need the prompt set.

sarah_marketing: Models: redwood-v1-1b (prod hash) and open-llama-7b. Seq: 128, 512, 2048. Batches: 1 and 8. Quant: fp16 baseline; int8 only if stable. Prefix cache: on/off. Put results in s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/bench-2026-03/ and include exact commands + commit sha. Deadline: Monday EOD but early CSVs helpful.

ajay_ml: Add a small quality sanity check: greedy decode on 150 holdout prompts and compute token-overlap; flag if int8 diverges >5%. Set seeds and disable dropout.

leo_data: Ill prep 150 holdout + 150 probes and upload to s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/bench-2026-03/payloads by EOD.

kevin_runtime: Plan: smoke runs today (seq128/512 x b1/8) on H100 and g5. Full matrix overnight. Well capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, peak mem, per-run cost estimate. Example harness:

```bash
python tools/bench/run_bench.py \
  --model redwood-v1-1b \
  --device h100 \
  --seq_len 512 \
  --batch_size 8 \
  --prefix_cache False \
  --quant fp16 \
  --seed 1234 \
  --out s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/bench-2026-03/results/redwood-v1-1b/
```

kevin_runtime: Well include nvprof traces, per-token timing for streaming, and run_metadata.txt with docker/image id, git sha, pytorch/cuda versions, and any kernel flags. ci-bot will queue jobs.

ci-bot: :gear: queued bench job webinar-1764012345. Watching s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/bench-2026-03/.

kevin_runtime: For cost calc well report both on-demand cloud pricing and our committed dedicated equivalent; please confirm which committed rate to use.

maya_sales: If numbers look strong, can marketing craft a 1-line non-technical blurb and share with sales for deck copy. Well need legal review.

sarah_marketing: Use our committed H100 internal rate for the committed baseline. Legal will review copy later. Acceptance: either p95 < 140ms for seq128 batch1 on H100 for redwood-v1-1b OR a clear story + cost-per-1M-token.

kevin_runtime: Copy. Starting smoke now; will post initial CSVs to the S3 path and update this thread. If quotas or flakiness show up well note it in run_metadata.txt.

sarah_marketing: Thanks everyone 4AA please ping when the first CSV is up.
